arguments:
{"script":"set -e
ws=group_count_workspace
mkdir -p "$ws"
chmod 700 "$ws" || true
rm -rf "$ws"/*

# copy main group file
cp /etc/group "$ws/raw_group_file.txt" 2>/dev/null || true

# copy any group fragments from common dirs
dirs="/etc/group.d /lib/group.d /usr/lib/group.d"
i=1
for d in $dirs; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    for f in "$d"/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      cp "$f" "$ws/group_fragment_${i}.txt"
      i=$((i+1))
    done
  fi
done

# extract non-blank, non-comment lines
if [ -f "$ws/raw_group_file.txt" ]; then
  grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' "$ws/raw_group_file.txt" > "$ws/group_lines.txt" || true
else
  > "$ws/group_lines.txt"
fi

# extract canonical group identifier (first field) and normalize (trim + lowercase)
if [ -s "$ws/group_lines.txt" ]; then
  awk -F: '{name=$1; gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",name); print tolower(name)}' "$ws/group_lines.txt" > "$ws/group_names_normalized.txt"
else
  > "$ws/group_names_normalized.txt"
fi

# unique group names (preserve first occurrence)
awk '!seen[$0]++' "$ws/group_names_normalized.txt" > "$ws/unique_group_names.txt"

# provenance file (leave numeric totals blank)
{
  echo "sources:"
  echo " - /etc/group -> raw_group_file.txt"
  for f in "$ws"/group_fragment_*.txt; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    echo " - $(basename "$f") (copied from /etc/group.d or similar)"
  done
  echo ""
  echo "processing steps:"
  echo " - Removed blank/comment lines -> group_lines.txt"
  echo " - Extracted canonical group field (first colon) and normalized -> group_names_normalized.txt"
  echo " - Removed duplicate identifiers -> unique_group_names.txt"
  echo ""
  echo "counts:"
  echo " - total_unique_groups: "
} > "$ws/unique_provenance.txt"

# ensure required files exist
for f in raw_group_file.txt group_lines.txt group_names_normalized.txt unique_group_names.txt unique_provenance.txt; do
  [ -e "$ws/$f" ] || touch "$ws/$f"
done

# manifest
{
  echo "Prepared files:"
  echo " - raw_group_file.txt"
  echo " - group_lines.txt"
  echo " - group_names_normalized.txt"
  echo " - unique_group_names.txt"
  echo " - unique_provenance.txt"
  echo ""
  echo "This workspace ($ws) is prepared for the final group count determination."
} > "$ws/manifest_ready_for_count.txt"

# Output the count only
wc -l < "$ws/unique_group_names.txt"
"}
